integrity: Analytical classification with an independently runnable finite diagnostic checker; finite diagnostics do not substitute for the infinite-parameter proof.
scientific_limitations: The exact count is at input gain zero and modulo vertical charge translations; the strictly positive input gain result is existential for each finite target multiplicity and gives no uniform or global basin bounds. Neutral stability thresholds and higher-period dynamics are not classified.
title: An unbounded attracting two-cycle staircase in a sine-charge memristive map
